start.derivation: Blend the pack idle and directional gait at shared contact phase using actual speed/acceleration; the complete Shared movement set has no generic authored start clip.

crouchEnter.derivation: Interpolate the copied idle and crouch lower-body poses following the existing motor crouch amount; no generic authored crouch-enter clip is present.

crouchExit.derivation: Reverse the idle/crouch pose interpolation following the existing motor stand-up amount.

directionChange.derivation: Interpolate adjacent authored 45-degree direction samples with phase synchronization; the eight authored gait directions themselves are copied.

diagonalJump.derivation: Blend the two adjacent copied N/E/S/W directional jump curves for diagonal takeoffs; no diagonal jump source is present.

ropeAttachDetach.derivation: Crossfade the copied rope lower poses with copied ground or falling poses at the implemented traversal boundary; no generic attach/detach movement clips are present.

mechanics.evidence: All directional ground gait roots are in place. Source curves establish cadence, posture and directional contact travel, not authoritative movement speed, acceleration, friction, stopping distance, gravity or rope speed. Existing motor values are preserved.

limitations: Contact phases and contact speeds are estimates from retargeted foot trajectories, not authored source events.
Animation-specific start, crouch-entry/exit and rope boundary timings are extrapolated blends.
Exact parity with Riot gameplay is unproven.

agentRowExtension.method: Derived from the baked jett rows (identity correction at the build reference) by per-bone rest-pose correction computed from each game-path agent GLB (models/valorant/agents/, the rigs the runtime animates): absolute q*corr, additive corr^-1*q*corr. Pelvis.position copied when the Splitter node matches jett, otherwise rotated into the agent Splitter frame via qX^-1*qJett (world-delta transfer; rest local translation is zero). The Rocklan pack was unavailable in this checkout; no new animation curves authored.

agentRowRedo.reason: frame-aware retarget (a skeleton whose parent frames differ from jett's, e.g. Brimstone 180 deg about Z): absolute C*(q*j^-1)*C^-1*x, C=P_X^-1*P_jett; additive D^-1*q*D, D=W_jett^-1*W_X; Pelvis.position kept (already in the agent Splitter frame)
